Doctor: The MRI findings showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement, combined with your normal CSF results, strongly suggest PML rather than Multiple Sclerosis. Have you recently been immunocompromised due to HIV, organ transplantation, or long-term immunosuppressive therapy?
